title: Private Cloud Delivery Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver customer infrastructure projects, working closely with internal technical teams, external suppliers and data centre operations.
  • Build, configure, test and troubleshoot physical and virtual servers, operating systems and supporting infrastructure.
  • Take an automation-first approach, developing scripts, reusable templates and repeatable deployment processes.
  • Ensure solutions are delivered in line with agreed designs, timescales, security requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide a high-quality and consistent technical infrastructure service to both internal and external customers.
  • Communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from technical teams through to senior executives, adapting your approach to suit the audience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, process improvement and better deployment practices.
  • Apply change management, configuration management and operational best practices across private and hybrid cloud deployments.
  • Produce clear and accurate technical documentation and ensure effective handover into Managed Services.
  • Maintain and develop your technical knowledge, contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Support additional infrastructure projects and technical activities where required.
  • Occasionally support out-of-hours customer changes, including disaster recovery testing, migrations and server configuration changes.
Who You'll Work With

You’ll collaborate with teams across the business, including:

  • Customer Experience & Managed Services to ensure solutions deliver a high-quality customer experience and transition smoothly into ongoing support.
  • Customer Success & Growth to support customer engagements and technical requirements.
  • Cloud Practice to ensure solutions align with established cloud architecture principles, standards and platforms.
  • Security, Networking & Data Centre Operations to coordinate infrastructure, connectivity, security and physical implementation requirements.
What We're Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Customer-focused and committed to delivering high-quality solutions.
  • A strong analytical thinker with excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Flexible, adaptable and comfortable working in a changing technical environment.
  • Self-motivated and able to manage priorities effectively.
  • A confident communicator who can work collaboratively with customers, technical teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement and automation.
  • Committed to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Able to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and ways of working.
Technical Skills & Experience

You’ll ideally bring experience across a range of the following technologies:

  • Virtualisation & Cloud: Hands-on experience with VMware, ideally including VMware Cloud Director, alongside a good understanding of private and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Operating Systems: Experience deploying, configuring and troubleshooting Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
  • Active Directory: Strong knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and Group Policy.
  • Windows Server: Knowledge of technologies such as Remote Desktop Services (RDS), Distributed File System (DFS) and Windows Server Failover Clustering.
  • Physical Infrastructure: Experience with physical server builds, RAID configurations, storage arrays and supporting compute infrastructure.
  • Storage: Knowledge of SAN and NAS technologies would be beneficial.
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery: Experience with backup and recovery technologies, ideally Veeam and/or Zerto, with a good understanding of resilience and disaster recovery principles.
  • Networking & Security: Working knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routing, firewalls and secure infrastructure configuration.
  • Automation: Practical PowerShell scripting experience, with an interest in Infrastructure as Code, automation and repeatable deployments.
  • Service Delivery: Understanding of change control, testing, technical documentation, service transition and operational handover.
  • Customer Engagement: The ability to explain technical information clearly and work effectively with customers and cross-functional technical teams.
